name: window-nativizer
description: GNOME Shell extension: fills in missing GNOME rounded corners and shadows, each only where absent

scripts.gen-style: node tools/gen-style.mjs && node tools/gen-shader.mjs && node tools/gen-mutter.mjs
scripts.check-style: node tools/gen-style.mjs --check && node tools/gen-shader.mjs --check && node tools/gen-mutter.mjs --check && node tools/gen-locale.mjs --check
scripts.pack: pnpm run compile-locales && mkdir -p dist && cp LICENSE src/LICENSE && gnome-extensions pack src --force --extra-source=lib --extra-source=effects --extra-source=stylesheet.css --extra-source=locale --extra-source=LICENSE --out-dir=dist && rm -f src/LICENSE
scripts.shexli: uvx --with 'tree-sitter<0.26.0' shexli dist/window-nativizer@everyx.github.io.shell-extension.zip || (pipx install --force shexli && pipx runpip shexli install 'tree-sitter<0.26.0' && shexli dist/window-nativizer@everyx.github.io.shell-extension.zip)
